I’ve had this mailbox for over a year with zero issues. It hasn’t rusted, faded, or jammed despite being exposed to sun, rain, and wind. The surface wipes clean easily, and the lock still works smoothly. The slot is conveniently sized for daily deliveries, and the interior capacity is generous. It’s a robust, long-term solution for secure mail handling.

Living in a rainy coastal area, I needed a mailbox that could withstand moisture. This unit delivers excellent waterproof performance thanks to the double-flap opening and sealed interior. The steel body is rust-resistant and holds up well against salt air. The lock mechanism is smooth and secure, and the internal baffle adds real anti-theft protection. It’s compact but has enough capacity for several days of mail.

I was pretty happy when I found this "trough door" mailbox as we needed a mailbox we could install in our front gate. It fits the intended purpose perfectly. It has been installed for a couple of months now and it seems the powdercoating is't as protective as I would have expected, so some faint rust spots are appearing. No big issue, I'm pretty sure that after a decent paint job this mailbox will serve us for many years to come.
